Assumption: Single premium specialty coffee shop, north Riyadh, with drive-thru, opened 2021
Value / Formula: Medium size: ~215 orders/day in 2023 rising to ~250 in 2025

Assumption: Prices are stored VAT-exclusive (VAT 15 %); menu prices are round VAT-inclusive numbers
Value / Formula: Unit_Price = menu/1.15

Assumption: Daily orders are the sum of 5 latent demand segments with their own weekly, hourly and seasonal behaviour
Value / Formula: Commuter, Student, Leisure, Family, Delivery

Assumption: Expected orders are multiplicative in components
Value / Formula: lambda[d,s] = base_s x Trend x Regime x MonthShock x MonthBehaviour x DOW x Climate x School x Salary x Ramadan x Holiday x Promo x Structural x Anomaly

Assumption: Realised orders are Poisson around a log-normally perturbed mean (over-dispersed counts)
Value / Formula: N ~ Poisson(lambda x exp(e_d + e_ds)), e_d ~ N(0, 0.055), e_ds ~ N(0, 0.045)

Assumption: Decelerating organic growth on log scale
Value / Formula: log Trend = 0.068 t - 0.002 t^2 (t in years)

Assumption: Slow-moving regime (strong / weak spells)
Calendar-month shocks: some months beat / miss expectations
Value / Formula: exp(N(0, 0.022)) per month + designed surprises Oct-23 +4 %, Jun-24 -5 %, Dec-24 +5 %, Feb-25 +3 %, Aug-25 -4 %

Assumption: Saudi week: Sun-Thu work/school, Fri-Sat weekend; Thursday night is the strongest social night
Value / Formula: Segment DOW tables (e.g. Commuter Fri 0.22, Leisure Thu 1.45, Family Fri 1.90)

Assumption: Weekend effect is NOT a fixed % - it is the result of segments with opposite weekly patterns
Value / Formula: Commuters/students collapse on Fri-Sat while leisure/families surge; mix varies with season

Assumption: Intraday demand per segment = sum of Gaussian bumps (morning commute ~07:25, afternoon students ~14:35, evening ~20:35, Thu late night)
Value / Formula: Bump centres jitter N(0, 0.15 h) and heights x exp(N(0, 0.08)) daily so no two days are identical

Assumption: Smooth month behaviour curve (cosine interpolated between month mid-points)
Riyadh daily mean temperature = climatology + AR(1) anomaly
Value / Formula: Monthly means 14.5..36.8 C; anomaly a_t = 0.8 a_{t-1} + N(0, 1.2)

Assumption: Leisure demand rises with outdoor comfort, families/leisure dip with summer travel abroad, delivery rises with heat
Value / Formula: Leisure x (0.84 + 0.28 exp(-((T-22)/9)^2)) x (1 - 0.14 travel); Delivery x (1 + 0.014 (T-26)); travel = Gaussian centred 24 Jul

Assumption: Iced share of drinks follows temperature
Value / Formula: share_iced = 0.20 + 0.66 / (1 + exp(-(T_eff - 25)/4.5)), T_eff = T + hour shift

Assumption: Shop closed during fasting hours; demand shifts to night; fewer commuters/students, more leisure/family/delivery
Value / Formula: Commuter 0.30, Student 0.45, Leisure 1.40, Family 1.25, Delivery 1.55 x intra-month curve (start 0.85 -> 1.0, last 10 nights x0.93, Eid eve x1.27)

Assumption: Baskets are larger (group gatherings, desserts, dallah)
Value / Formula: Drinks per order x1.2, food x1.25, desserts weight x1.6, Saudi Qahwa x2.2

Assumption: Eid day 1 is quiet in the morning (prayer, family visits) and strong in the evening; days 2-3 strongest; city empties afterwards (travel)
Value / Formula: e.g. Eid Al-Fitr day 2: Leisure x1.30, Family x1.45 on a weekend baseline; post-Eid days x0.6-0.95

Assumption: National Day / Founding Day behave like a weekend plus celebration uplift and a promotion
Value / Formula: National Day: Leisure x1.30, Family x1.25 on a Saturday baseline + National Day Offer 20 %

Assumption: Government payday on the 27th (Thursday if it falls on Fri/Sat); spending lift decays, end-of-cycle squeeze
Value / Formula: salary = 1 + 0.09 exp(-k/2.5) - 0.045 clip((k-14)/12, 0, 1); sensitivity Leisure/Family/Delivery 1.0, Student 0.5, Commuter 0.3

Assumption: Students vanish in summer and term breaks; exams raise late-night study visits
Value / Formula: Student: Summer 0.20, Break 0.45, Exams 1.10 (+ 22:50 bump)

Assumption: Promotions lift traffic, raise new-customer acquisition and cut margin; White Friday borrows from the following week
Value / Formula: White Friday 20 % off: Delivery x1.35, Leisure x1.25; next 7 days x0.93-0.96

Assumption: Hour-specific promotion: Summer Iced Happy Hour (2024, 2025 only - 2023 is the control year)
Value / Formula: 25 % off iced drinks Sun-Thu 14:00-17:00; segment demand in window x1.2-1.45

Assumption: Stable base prices, 5 scheduled price changes and 5 cost changes; demand elasticity on relative price
Value / Formula: weight x (price/initial price)^-0.8

Assumption: Persistent members with heterogeneous visit rates
Value / Formula: visit weight ~ Gamma(0.7-1.0, 1); 35 % of new members never return; lifetime ~ Exp(220-420 days)

Assumption: Members re-order their favourite drink 55 % of the time (switching to the iced counterpart when hot)
Value / Formula: Favourite drawn at sign-up from segment preferences

Assumption: Loyalty: every 10 stamped drinks earns a free drink
Value / Formula: Cheapest drink on the order discounted 100 % for one unit

Assumption: Mobile app adoption follows a saturating curve after launch
Value / Formula: app share = 0.03 + 0.15 (1 - exp(-days/240))

Assumption: Missing values only where they occur in real POS data
Value / Formula: Payment 0.35 %, Channel 0.25 %, Time 0.05 % + POS outage orders; Customer_ID empty for guests

Assumption: Corporate bulk orders (5-20 units per line) ~1.7-2.3 per month, plus 2 per year before national days
Value / Formula: Payment = Corporate Invoice, 10 % discount

Value / Formula: See ground_truth_daily_components.csv
